scope: model forward only; CUDA synchronized; per-pair latency from batch evaluation

memory.scope: full confirmation invocation; not isolated batch-size-1 inference peak

limitations: The stored run used batch size 32, not batch size 1.
It ran on an A100, not the Apple M3 used by the deployment benchmark.
Only a median model-forward latency was stored; no p95 or p99 samples survive.
The CUDA peak-memory counters cover the confirmation invocation and are not an isolated inference peak.
This record must not be used for a same-hardware speed ranking against Ridge or certified RB-SR.
